content: Refresh origin refs before classifying local work. Bare clones need remote.origin.fetch=+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*. Use senshac-workspace/main for coordination and repos/<name>/main for focused work; Warren owns its separate project clones.

outcomes.notes: Fetched origin/main in all six repositories before classifying branch state; verified each local main now exactly matches its remote and has a clean worktree.

content: Audit local branches against fetched GitHub state and merged PR head SHA. Worktrunk may retain branches even on exit zero; verify refs after removal. Preserve closed-but-unmerged Warren branches for review.

outcomes.notes: Matched local refs to merged GitHub PR head SHAs; removed verified merged local refs and pruned only stale remote-tracking refs. Preserved WIP and active worktree refs.

content: When using Mulch v0.11.0, treat doctor stale-record warnings as an age-only count; use mulch stale for actionable review because it accounts for confirmation, changed or missing anchors, and supersession. Report both metrics separately, and do not reclassify or archive solely to make doctor green.

outcomes.notes: Confirmed Mulch v0.11.0 source behavior: doctor uses age/classification-only isRecordStale; stale command additionally checks confirmation, anchors, and supersession. Applied this distinction across all six repos.
outcomes.test_results: Current six-repo doctor/stale counts recorded in docs/repository-status-2026-10-08.md; all six stale commands return zero candidates after the review.
